intro.heading: BHUMIKA
intro.description: I am a Computer Science undergraduate at JIS University, Kolkata, working as a Digital Product Developer and a core contributor at Elixpo — skilled across frontend and back-end development, API integration, database design, and dashboard/reporting tools. I like translating real-world problems into working, data-driven products.

fancySection.subtitle: Experience & Interests
fancySection.content: I am currently a core contributor at Elixpo, working across multiple products including accounts.elixpo, blogs.elixpo, sketch.elixpo, opensource.elixpo, and payouts.elixpo alongside the core team, and a GSSoC 2026 contributor on NexaSphere. My hands-on experience also spans applied AI product-building (VAANI, a real-time sign-language-to-speech accessibility tool), full-stack data applications (Financial-Log), and dashboard/UI design (CampusPulse). I'm comfortable presenting technical work to non-technical audiences, having pitched a product to judges at a hackathon, and enjoy collaborating in fast-paced, cross-functional team settings.
fancySection.contactNote: Interested in digital, data, or AI-focused initiatives with real-world impact? Feel free to reach out.
fancySection.shoutoutText: for the environment to build and ship real, collaborative open-source projects.
